ns0:media.alt: The figure has two curved lines graphed on the x y-coordinate plane. The x-axis runs from negative 6 to 6. The y-axis runs from negative 6 to 6. The curved line on the left goes through the points (negative 3, 0), (negative 4, 2), and (negative 4, negative 2). The curved line on the right goes through the points (3, 0), (4, 2), and (4, negative 2).
